[{"id":"script-mv889lpsndl3","name":"Get PID & PPID of a Running Process","language":"Powershell","body":"<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Finds the parent process of a process on a remote computer.

.DESCRIPTION
    Prompts for a remote computer and either a PID or a process name, then
    uses Invoke-Command to look the process up over WinRM and report its
    parent (PID, name, and command line).
#>

# Prompt for the remote machine and the process to look up
$computerName = Read-Host 'Enter remote computer name or ip'
$target       = (Read-Host 'Enter pid or process name').Trim()

# Uncomment to authenticate as a different user (and keep -Credential below)
# $creds = Get-Credential

# Run the lookup on the remote machine; $target is passed in as -ArgumentList
# because the remote script block can't see local variables
Invoke-Command -Credential $creds `
    -ComputerName $computerName `
    -ArgumentList $target `
    -ScriptBlock {
        param([string]$target)

        # Build a WMI filter: all digits = PID, otherwise treat as a process
        # name (".exe" optional)
        if ($target -match '^\d+$') {
            $filter = "ProcessId = $target"
        }
        else {
            # Win32_Process names include the extension, so add it if missing
            $name = if ($target -like '*.exe') { $target } else { "$target.exe" }

            # Double any single quotes so the name can't break out of the filter
            $filter = "Name = '$($name -replace "'", "''")'"
        }

        # @() forces an array even when zero or one process matches
        $procs = @(Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Process -Filter $filter)

        # Nothing matched: report it and stop
        if (-not $procs) {
            Write-Error "No process matching '$target' was found"
            return
        }

        # A name can match several processes, so report each one's parent
        foreach ($proc in $procs) {
            # Look up the parent using the ParentProcessId from the match
            $parent = Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = $($proc.ParentProcessId)"

            # Emit one row per match: the process, then its parent
            [pscustomobject]@{
                ProcessId       = $proc.ProcessId
                Name            = $proc.Name
                ParentProcessId = $proc.ParentProcessId
                ParentName      = $parent.Name
                ParentCommand   = $parent.CommandLine
            }
        }
    }"},{"id":"script-mv8afxxap76y","name":"Ping a set of IP addresses","language":"Bash","tags":["ping","test","ip"],"body":"#!/bin/bash
